pricing.policy: VERIFIED requires an already confirmed price or at least two dated Romanian/comparable-market offers from distinct domains. LOW-quality matches never qualify.

competitorSales.policy: Proxy demand, result counts, ratings and lifetime sold counts are never presented as 30-day sales. VERIFIED_SALES requires a dated observation with actual units30d or revenue30d from a named source.

supplierCommercial.policy: Supplier is commercially verified only when a dated source-linked quote explicitly includes unit price, MOQ, shippingRon, sampleCostRon and a positive leadTimeDays. Missing numeric fields are never coerced to zero.

reviewEvidence.policy: Review evidence requires at least two concrete snippets across one or more named sources. Comparable-product evidence informs pain points but does not prove sales.

testBuyDecision.policy: TEST requires all verified commercial gates. BUY additionally requires a completed real test with healthy sell-through, actual margin and unit profit. Proxies cannot satisfy verified gates.

buyGate.requirements: BUY necesită TEST real finalizat, sell-through ≥60%, marjă reală ≥15% și profit/unitate pozitiv.

goldenPipeline.policy: DISCOVERED → top 15 PROMISING → top 5 VALIDATE → max 3 FINALIST when evidence is credible → TEST_READY only after all commercial gates → BUY_READY only after a successful real test.

trendPolicy: Trend Intelligence folosește numai snapshoturile istorice interne și nu modifică verdictul TEST/CUMPĂRĂ.
opportunityRankingPolicy: Opportunity Ranking V2 este separat de Launch Score și verdictul comercial. Scorul este plafonat când lipsesc dovezi, pricing verificat, competitor evidence sau istoric suficient.

freeIntelligenceSuite.policy: Toate modulele gratuite folosesc doar date deja observate/derivate și nu modifică pragurile TEST/CUMPĂRĂ.

calibration.policy: Weights must not auto-calibrate before at least 5 completed real commercial tests.

commercialHardening.policy: Commercial facts are separated from proxies. Missing evidence never becomes zero or verified. Public provider evidence may reduce unknowns but cannot bypass TEST/BUY gates.

testBuyEngine.policy: TEST cere toate gate-urile comerciale; BUY cere suplimentar performanță reală după lotul de test.
